instruction: Apply a sepia tone filter to the photo on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: GIMP color filter task variation. Requires applying a sepia tone effect to an image. Infeasible due to inability to verify color transformation results without pixel-level comparison or image analysis capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - sepia tone filter verification requires pixel-level color transformation analysis
No existing GIMP metric functions can verify sepia tone color space conversion (only brightness/contrast/saturation/structure similarity available)
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate classification for this unverifiable task
Metadata explanation accurately describes why verification is impossible with current capabilities
